review.evidenceBasis: Checked all 45 mapping rows (45 videos, lessonRef null) against the Edexcel IAL M1 spine (1.1-6.1), title-only evidence, applying the higher cross-subject physics->maths-mechanics bar. Kept rows whose titles name spec-listed content (scalars/vectors and resultants 2.1, SUVAT and d-t/v-t/speed-t graphs 3.1, Newton's laws 4.1, momentum/impulse 4.3, friction F=muR 4.4/5.3, weight within the 5.2 force list, moments/couples 6.1); 1.1 (modelling assumptions) and 4.2 (connected particles) are correctly unbound. Two spec-level rejects: both GCSE 'Speed' videos bound to 2.2, which demands application of VECTORS to displacements, velocities, accelerations and forces in a plane — speed is not among the spec's quantities and no vector framing is title-evidenced, unlike 'Velocity'/'Acceleration' rows which do name listed quantities and stay at low.

rejects.reason: GCSE 'Speed' is keyword-adjacent only: 2.2 is 'Application of vectors to displacements, velocities, accelerations and forces in a plane' — speed is not among the spec's listed quantities (it is the scalar side of 2.1, to which this video is not bound) and no vectors/in-a-plane mathematical framing is title-evidenced
